title: ARSIA Key Revocation
description: Validates payload.data of an event with payload type arsiaprotocol.identity/key-revocation (ARSIA-Identity.md §2.5; ARSIA-Core.md §5.2, Verification Caching). The binding of revoked_kid and of the signing key to the event's from, and the rule that the signing key differs from revoked_kid, are runtime checks (Identity §2.5).

revoked_kid.description: kid of the revoked key; its agent-id prefix equals the event's from (runtime). Per ARSIA-Identity.md §2.5.

allOf.description: Instant from which signatures by the revoked key are invalid; for an emergency rotation, the compromise instant (ARSIA-Core.md §5.2, compromise-window accounting). It never delays the recipient's invalidation. Per ARSIA-Identity.md §2.5.
